body:
The repo moved from `Btabor11` to `RDW-Labz` (OASIS decision #63). Installs read `package.json`, so this goes in now instead of relying on GitHub's redirect.

- `package.json`: `repository.url` → `https://github.com/RDW-Labz/project-swarm.git`. Version 1.5.0 → 1.5.1, so release.yml tags `v1.5.1` with the new URL.
- README (2 clone URLs, plus the owner note) and `docs/setup.md` clone URL.
- Left as is: `docs/automation-integration-study.md` links to `Btabor11/cluer-crm-pipeline`, which did not move.
